formal.subject: Re: Quick Qs about AIIoT 2027 registration, hotel and invoice
formal.body:
Dear Ms. Johnson,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding AIIoT 2027. The student author early-bird fee is USD 280, and the early-bird deadline is May 1, 2027. The student rate requires valid full-time student status and a student ID or official enrollment certificate. Eligibility remains subject to verification of those requirements. We cannot confirm that a payment made next week will qualify for the early-bird fee; the USD 280 rate applies only if payment is completed by May 1, 2027 and the eligibility requirements are met.

Hotel and accommodation information has not yet been announced. We are therefore unable to provide hotel recommendations, confirm walking distance or a conference participant discount, state a nightly rate, or confirm breakfast arrangements at this time.

[HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED] Invoice policy and tax-ID handling are not currently available. We cannot promise that an invoice will be issued, that your university's full name and tax ID can be included, or that an invoice can be provided before payment. Your invoice request requires review by the conference secretariat.

We hope this information is helpful. Please let us know if you have any further questions.

Sincerely,
Conference Secretariat
AIIoT 2027
